overview: SKeep is a comprehensive digital financial management system for SK Treasurers and SK Chairpersons in the Philippines. It covers transaction recording, budget management, COA compliance reporting, project tracking, receipt storage, supplier management, audit trails, and a subscription system — all in a professional, government-style interface.
features: Real-time financial dashboard with income/expense charts
Full transaction recording with check payment module
Annual budget setup and program allocation tracking
SK project management with document uploads
COA compliance center (QSRP, RAAF, ASRP, Budget vs Actual)
BIR & Supplier database with tax tracking
Receipt & document management with cloud storage
In-app notification center with budget and deadline alerts
Full audit trail and activity logging
Subscription system with ₱99/month plan and GCash payment
